fusions.name: Snap Reach
fusions.desc: A ranged blow that deals 4 damage, up to 2 times at maximum range. Each hit has a 30% chance of leaving the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Belly Flop
fusions.desc: Slams down on every enemy within 3 tiles; each hit deals 14 damage and stuns for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Mud Wallow
fusions.desc: Restores 18 health to you. Its healing rises +8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%).

fusions.name: Spring Back
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, 20 stamina comes back to you. Once every 20 seconds.
